nodes.name: Verify signature
nodes.notes: HMAC-SHA256 over `${timestamp}.${rawBody}` with LENDLOOP_WEBHOOK_SECRET (env var, never in this file). 5 minute replay window, constant-time compare.

nodes.name: Drop duplicate events
nodes.notes: Convex retries until it gets a 2xx, so the same eventId can arrive twice (e.g. a timeout after we already answered). Each eventId is processed once.

nodes.name: Look up email in Clerk (optional)
nodes.notes: Optional real email path. Needs a Header Auth credential (Authorization: Bearer <Clerk secret key>) created in n8n. The email is fetched only at send time and never stored in Convex.

nodes.name: Send email (optional)
nodes.notes: Optional. Needs an SMTP credential created in n8n.
